en.bdb: The Sikh of the Guru is the follower of truth -

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰੀ ਚੰਦ ਸਤਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਨਿਖਾਸ ਵਿਕਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: haree cha(n)dh sat rakhiaa jai nikhaas vikaanaa|

en.bdb: Harischandr abided by truth and got himself sold in the market place.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਲ ਛਲਿਆ ਸਤ ਪਾਲਦਾ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ਸਿਧਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: bal chhaliaa sat paaladhaa paataal sidhaanaa|

en.bdb: Though duped (by Visnu), King Bali observed truth and went to the netherworld.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨੁ ਸੁ ਕੰਚਨ ਦਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਪਛੋਤਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: karanu su ka(n)chan dhaan kar a(n)t pachhotaanaa|

en.bdb: Karn would also give gold in charity but he had to repent ultimately (because god Indr demanded his armour ana earrings of him which he readily gave and lost his powers).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਵਾਦੀ ਹੁਇ ਧਰਮ ਪੁਤੁ ਕੂੜ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: sativaadhee hui dharam put kooR jamapur jaanaa|

en.bdb: The truthful Yudhisthar, son of Yama, for his one lie had to go to hell.
Many celebates, truthful and contented people have flourished but they all were proud of their conduct.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit_en: gursikh rom na pujanee bahu maan nimaanaa ||8||

en.bdb: Such a humble one is the Sikh of the Guru that all these are not equal to his one trichome.
